Eve —

Following our call this morning with Amira (Neurolytics ops), they want to consolidate two active SOWs (Q1 pilot + alpha lic) into a single enterprise agreement effective July 1. The ask from procurement is two-fold and time-sensitive:

- Consolidation credit: apply a retroactive credit to cover overlap for the current quarter (~$36k) so their finance team can close July invoices in a single PO.
- Packaging discount: a short-term blended discount for first 12 months (6% additional off list) in exchange for a 24-month consolidated commitment.

Why this matters: overall ARR increases (they commit to a consolidated annualized spend ~x1.8 of current). The finance team flagged that if we don’t provide a consolidation credit they cannot net the two invoices, which will delay procurement by >3 weeks.

I ran a quick impact calc — see attached pricing worksheet and the proposed consolidation plan. Net present value still looks positive for Redwood; however, this is outside our delegated approval for AE-level discounts and requires VP/CFO sign-off for the retro credit and the blended concession.

Requesting: can you escalate to Karthik for a one-off credit authorization and quick note to provide to their CFO? If approved, I’ll send the redline and DocuSign.

Attachments: Neurolytics_MA_consolidation_plan.xlsx, proposed_pricing_worksheet.csv

Eve / team —

Thanks for the clear note and the numbers. A couple of quick clarifying asks before I sign off:

1) Confirmed NPV: the worksheet shows NPV positive at our current discount schedule; can you add a sensitivity row for +/−1% and a churn-assumption (1.5%)?
2) Recovery mechanics: is the consolidation credit a true refund to cover prior invoices or a one-off invoice credit applied to the July invoice? We need the latter for revenue recognition control.
3) Approval gating: legal needs the merged SOW redline and procurement needs the DocuSign stub to confirm PO sequencing.

If we can get the sensitivity and confirm the credit will be applied as a July invoice credit (not cash refund), I’m comfortable approving up to $40k conditional on the three requirements you listed. Please get me the updated worksheet and the redline; I’ll aim to send an approval email with the CFO subject line by end of day Tuesday 6/16.
